UnitStatement: CaePipeMbfConversionWitness type records witness_id, source_ref, field_path, source/target quantity, conversion_factor_to_target, conversion_status, and decision_basis_refs for a unit conversion.
CaePipeMbfLossCategory is the closed set: exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, tbd.
CAEPIPE_MBF_EXPORT_VERSION constant is "0.1.0".
CAEPIPE_MBF_TARGET_LENGTH_UNIT is "mm"; the MBF smoke subset converts node coordinates to millimeters.
Carried TBDs TARGET_VERSION_TBD (TBD-17-01-001), RECORD_SUBSET_TBD (TBD-17-01-002), and DIRECT_STABLE_ID_TBD (TBD-17-01-003) remain open for CAEPIPE MBF export.
REQUIRED_LOSS_CATEGORIES mandates all six loss categories: exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, tbd.
CaepipeMbfExportPanel React component builds and renders the CAEPIPE MBF export packet from model, result, and analysisRun.

buildCaePipeMbfExportPacket assembles the CAEPIPE MBF export package: profile, payload, MBF text, conversion witnesses, unit disclosure, stable-id map, loss report, diagnostics, and validation report.
CAEPIPE MBF validation_status is boundary_checked when blocking diagnostic count is zero, otherwise blocked.
caepipeMbfExportProfile declares profile ops.caepipe_mbf.smoke_tbd with sidecar stable-ID policy, mandatory loss-report policy, and external_execution_policy not_invoked_by_this_package.
CAEPIPE MBF output is a bounded desktop smoke-subset package; target version, record subset closure, and direct MBF stable-ID carrying remain TBD.
caepipeMbfPayload sorts nodes, pipe segments, supports, and load cases by id and assigns deterministic target IDs (N/P/S/L prefixes).
caepipeMbfPayload converts node x/y/z coordinates to millimeters using the source length unit (default meters).
caepipeMbfConversionWitnesses emits one conversion witness per node coordinate axis (x, y, z) for each node.
conversion_status is source_unit_matches_target_unit when the conversion factor is 1, otherwise converted_to_target_unit.
expectedCaePipeMbfConversionWitnessCount equals model node count multiplied by 3.
renderCaePipeMbfText emits ASCII MBF records: UNITS, NODES, ELEMENTS (PIPE), SUPPORTS, LOAD_CASES, terminated by an END record.
caepipeMbfStableIdMap maps canonical Node, PipeElement, Support, and LoadCase IDs to their MBF target IDs as a sidecar mapping.

caepipeMbfLossReport emits one loss entry per category (exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, tbd) with affected refs, reason, source-basis ref, governing TBD, and downstream implication.
Diagnostic MBF-SMOKE-SUBSET-MISSING (blocking) fires when the payload has no nodes or no pipe elements.
Diagnostic MBF-TEXT-NON-ASCII (blocking) fires when rendered MBF text contains non-ASCII characters.
Diagnostic MBF-NODE-COORDINATE-UNIT-TBD (blocking) fires when the model length unit is not a supported millimeter-conversion unit.
supportKind returns ANCHOR when all six restraints (UX,UY,UZ,RX,RY,RZ) are present, GUIDE when some restraints exist, else SUPPORT.
targetId formats a prefixed zero-padded 3-digit target identifier from a prefix and index.
convertLengthToMillimeters multiplies by factor 1000 for unit meters, else factor 1; result is rounded to 6 decimals.
isSupportedMillimeterConversionUnit accepts only units m and mm.
CAEPIPE MBF export is a local invented smoke-subset package; it makes no CAEPIPE compatibility, solver validation, release, code compliance, or professional reliance claim.
ComparisonPanel limits visible deltas to MAX_VISIBLE_DELTAS = 4.
ComparisonPanel renders local comparison workspace summary: reference/target bases, mapped comparable pairs, tolerance status, and boundary.
ComparisonRow renders a selectable delta row showing right_result_id, classification, entity_ref, component, location, and raw delta with unit.
comparisonBoundary asserts review-only comparison with no compliance, certification, sealing, authentication, or approval claim when human review is required and all such claims are false.
DesignWorkspacePanel builds and renders the design-authoring comparison workspace packet from model, knowledge, result, run, comparison, editor intents, proposal, and selected review target.
buildDesignWorkspacePacket composes operation records from editor intents and an optional agent proposal for review.
Design workspace packet is document_kind design_authoring_comparison_workspace, deliverable DEL-07-08, package PKG-07, scope SOW-076.

Design workspace mutation_boundary records that the workspace does not mutate accepted model state and routes GUI-originated changes through structured operation or application-service command intent only.
Design workspace evidence is a local preview composition that does not apply operations, mutate accepted model state, or create professional approval.
professionalBoundary requires human review and asserts no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
DiagnosticsPanel merges model, knowledge, and result diagnostics, supports text filtering, and shows a selected diagnostic's interpretation detail.
DiagnosticControls provides a filter input, visible-count summary, clear control, and severity counts (blocking, error, warning, info).
countBySeverity tallies diagnostics into blocking, error, warning, and info buckets.
filterDiagnostics matches the query (case-insensitive) against id, code, severity, source, message, and affected refs.
DiffPreviewPanel builds the operation diff preview packet and renders queued operation diffs with before/after context.
buildDiffPreviewPacket aggregates editor-intent and agent-proposal previews; accepted_model_state_mutated is always false.
editorIntentPreview marks each GUI editor-intent diff as held_for_user_acceptance, not applied, with no accepted-state mutation and no hash-bound diff.
proposalPreview marks each agent-proposal diff as held_for_user_acceptance requiring explicit user acceptance, with unit and dimension TBD.
Diff previews are local review evidence only; the panel does not apply operations, mutate accepted model state, or create professional acceptance.
EditorKind is material, component, or rule_pack_reference.
EditorValidationState is ready_for_service_validation, blocked_by_private_rule_inputs, or blocked_by_user_supplied_modifier.
EditorContractPanel builds and renders the editor contract review packet from editor intents and the model.
buildEditorContractPacket assembles material, component, and rule-pack-reference editors plus diagnostics, surface inventory, rule-pack reference, and boundary flags.
Editor contract command_policy is bounded_apply_cancel_intents_only; private_payload_policy is references_and_checksums_only_no_private_payload_copy.

Editor contract source_of_truth_boundary: GUI is not source of truth, mutation routes through application-service validation before persistence, direct model mutation not allowed, accepted model state not mutated.
materialEditors builds editor fields for label, elastic modulus, shear modulus, thermal expansion coefficient, and provenance with explicit unit and dimension metadata.
componentEditors blocks a component editor as blocked_by_user_supplied_modifier when provenance indicates no_flexibility_factor.
rulePackReferenceEditor references a not-loaded user-supplied rule pack with redacted private payload and validation_state blocked_by_private_rule_inputs.
editorDiagnostics emits RULE_PACK_CHECKSUM_TBD, RULE_PACK_REQUIRED_INPUTS_MISSING, and PRIVATE_LIBRARY_PAYLOAD_NOT_LOADED warnings for missing private rule-pack and library inputs.
COMPONENT_MODIFIER_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED diagnostic warns that SIF, flexibility, and proprietary component data must be treated as user-supplied or privately imported with provenance.
Editor unit contract (DEL-02-02): unit-bearing values require explicit unit metadata; missing unit behavior is diagnostic_blocking.

Editor records are review-only command intent context; private rule packs, libraries, durable mutation, approval, authentication, certification, sealing, and code-compliance claims are not bundled or generated.

ExportAdapterTarget type captures target_id, target_family, registry_state, source_basis_state, stable_id_policy, loss_report_policy, validation_status, and unresolved TBD refs with all support/compatibility/solver/compliance/reliance claim flags false.
ExportAdapterSdkPanel builds and renders the export-adapter SDK target-registry preview packet.
buildExportAdapterSdkPacket assembles the SDK contract, adapter template, target registry, state binding, validation report, and diagnostics for the export-adapter SDK preview.
Export-adapter SDK capabilities are export_model, export_results, validate_payload, and emit_diagnostics.
Export-adapter SDK runtime_model leaves transport protocol, endpoint syntax, plugin runtime, permission taxonomy, sandbox mechanism, grant persistence, and adapter loader as TBD.

Required adapter sections include target_version_basis, source_basis_refs, unit_policy, coordinate_policy, stable_id_policy, loss_report_policy, diagnostics_policy, boundary_notes, and validation_checklist.
exportAdapterTargets registers five preview targets: native JSON package, stress-neutral CSV/JSON package, review geometry export, conservative PCF export, and CAEPIPE MBF export.
EXPORT-ADAPTER-SDK-MISSING-COMMON-CONTRACT (blocking) fires when a target registry entry lacks the DEL-17-02 common export contract reference.
EXPORT-ADAPTER-SDK-SUPPORT-CLAIM (blocking) fires when a target entry attempts to claim support or compatibility from preview metadata.

denyByDefaultControls denies filesystem, network, process, private-data access and all bypasses by default while requiring public API boundary, schema/unit validation, provenance, protected-content screening, export review, loss report, and stable-id map.
Export-adapter SDK output is a local target-registry preview; plugin runtime, permissions, transport, target compatibility, and support claims remain governed TBDs.
ExportReviewPanel builds and renders the local export safety review manifest aggregating all preview export surfaces.
buildExportReviewManifest assembles the export review manifest with per-export readiness, deliverable refs, source refs, redaction action, and boundary flags.
project_storage_audit export records local storage capability, local-only boundary, and non-mutating review context (DEL-02-05/DEL-12-01/DEL-12-02).
project_validation_preflight export records schema/version, migration, and round-trip category evidence.
telemetry_boundary_review export (DEL-12-03) keeps telemetry disabled/default-off with no payload or network initialized; all 4 attempted events are blocked.
secret_private_library_boundary_review export (DEL-12-04) keeps private libraries, paths, and credential references metadata-only with no secret material or concrete paths.
security_threat_model_review export (DEL-12-05) summarizes 19 threats (14 high risk) across 10 asset classes and 10 trust boundaries without claiming security sufficiency.
editor_contract_review export (DEL-07-03) reports 4 editors, 7 surfaces, with private rule packs and libraries represented by references only and no direct model mutation.
missing_data_warning_blocking_review export (DEL-07-04) keeps solve-required and rule-check-required data distinct, does not auto-fill missing values, and reports rule-check blocked.
accessibility_usability_baseline_review export (DEL-07-06) reports deterministic GUI-contract findings without selecting a final conformance target.
design_authoring_comparison_workspace export (DEL-07-08) composes knowledge, constraints, state/run, comparison, overlays, and operation diff review without mutating accepted model state.
build_package_readiness export provides provider-neutral local build/package readiness metadata with CI provider, release matrix, signing, and publishing TBD and no release authorization.
validation_release_evidence_review export (DEL-09-04/DEL-09-05) records validation manual sections, evidence inventory, readiness profiles, and release-gate families without authorizing release.
result_envelope export is a schema-first local JSON result envelope; non-JSON formats, public transport, and local FEA package formats remain TBD.
stress_neutral_csv_json_package export emits fixed result columns, stable IDs, loss report, and diagnostic-only comparison semantics with no pass/fail.
headless_runner_envelope export is a schema-first local request/result envelope; final CLI syntax, process, network, filesystem, CI, and release matrix remain TBD.
adapter_framework_envelope export is a format-neutral adapter declaration; concrete formats, transport, plugin runtime, and redaction workflow remain TBD.
local_fea_handoff_package export is a target-neutral local shell/solid FEA handoff preview with mesh, target format, adapter, and external solver invocation TBD.
external_prover_boundary_metadata export is metadata-only external-prover workflow context with no external tool invocation or commercial result ingestion.
review_geometry_export emits local glTF 2.0 JSON visual-review geometry with stable-ID sidecar metadata; not solver geometry or compatibility evidence.
conservative_pcf_export is a local PCF review package with sidecar stable IDs, mandatory loss report, and blocking TBDs for target profile and nominal size.
caepipe_mbf_export is a local CAEPIPE MBF smoke-subset review package with sidecar stable IDs, mandatory loss report, and carried TBDs for target version, record subset, and direct stable-ID carrier.
caepipe_external_run_evidence export is a parser-only evidence preview with executable path absent and external execution not attempted.
export_adapter_sdk_registry export is a local SDK target-registry preview with 5 targets; source-basis admission, plugin runtime, permissions, and transport remain TBD.
native_json_package export is a project-owned native JSON review package; physical container, public transport, and canonical package hash remain TBD.
report_packet export is a schema-first local JSON report packet that does not bundle private rule criteria.
report_protected_content_lint export is a heuristic public report-surface lint whose clean output is not legal, redaction, release, or professional clearance.
handoff_package export is a native open JSON preview profile with target-specific solver mapping deferred.
operation_review_ledger export records held-for-user-acceptance review records only, applying no accepted-state mutation.
Export review redaction_policy: public/shared export not allowed, local private export allowed, private values redacted, protected content blocked, source model not mutated.
Export review is a local technical-preview manifest only; it does not certify redaction, release readiness, or professional acceptance.

ExportUnitSystemDisclosure type records unit_system_ref, model/result/target units, conversion policy/scope, decision basis refs, and storage_convention entered_units_preserved with no protected or private payload.

buildExportUnitSystemDisclosure builds a DEC-018 unit-system disclosure preserving entered units, recording target export units, conversion policy/scope, and decision basis refs DEC-018 and DEL-02-02.
unitDisclosureSummary formats a one-line summary of source units, target units, result units, and whether conversion was performed.
formatUnitRecord renders a sorted comma-joined key=value list of unit entries, returning none when empty.
ExternalProverBoundaryPanel builds and renders the external-prover boundary metadata packet from model, result, and analysisRun.

buildExternalProverBoundaryPacket assembles non-authoritative external-prover workflow metadata: names, tags, notes, external references, attachments, context links, unsupported flags, and diagnostics (DEL-15-04).
External-prover attachments carry payload_embedded false and content-hash references only, with no payload ingestion.
unsupported_target_flags record external_solver_not_invoked, commercial_result_ingestion_deferred, and formal_prover_status_not_generated as not_implemented.
externalProverDiagnostics emit EPM-DESKTOP-METADATA-ONLY, EXTERNAL-EXECUTION-NOT-INVOKED, COMMERCIAL-RESULT-NOT-INGESTED, and an authority-flags diagnostic.
tbdChecksum produces a TBD-algorithm checksum reference scoped to the project when no run hashes are available.

External-prover professionalBoundary asserts metadata_only true; external_tool_invoked, commercial_result_payload_ingested, and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication/reliance claims false.
External-prover metadata is descriptive review context only; external tools, target parsers, and human-owned acceptance records remain outside this preview packet.
